notes.subject: ויצליחו
notes.rationale: 'Na ol i go het gutpela yet' — KJV 'yet they prosper' (bikos ol no skelim) vs ASV/JPS 'that they might prosper' (skelim bilong halivim pikinini papa i dai).

notes.subject: דין ... דנו ... דין
notes.rationale: Tripela tok 'kot/skelim' insait long wanpela lain — repetisen, i save strong long Tok Pisin tu.

notes.subject: עברו דברי רע
notes.rationale: 'Ol i winim moa yet ol wok bilong man nogut' — literal 'ol i go pas olgeta long tok/ol wok bilong nogut'.

translation: Ol i kamap gris, ol i sait; ol i winim moa yet ol wok bilong man nogut; ol i no skelim kot, kot bilong pikinini papa i dai; na ol i go het gutpela yet; na pasin bilong skelim bilong ol man no gat samting, ol i no skelim.

tokens.gloss: na ol i go het gutpela yet
bilong ol man no gat samting
